scope: Finite CardFactory rarity fallback/empty pool fault rules; known manual CardReward reroll fault prefix. Installed UI/task recovery is not inferred.

contracts.missing_rarity: After blacklisting chosen canonical cards, start at the rolled rarity and cycle Common -> Uncommon -> Rare -> Common; select uniformly within the first nonempty rarity only. Do not select uniformly over all remaining rarities.
contracts.pity: CardRarityOdds.Roll updates future rarity odds from the rolled rarity before the factory picks a fallback card; a fallback Rare does not itself reset the offset.
contracts.nonuniform_empty: Roll base or encounter rarity once, then fail with InvalidOperationException when no valid rarity exists. No item or upgrade draw.
contracts.uniform_empty: NextItem(empty) returns null without RNG, then CardFactory throws InvalidOperationException.
contracts.exhausted_pool: The blacklist excludes each chosen canonical model. A request that exhausts the factory pool faults; it does not return a partial reward.
contracts.manual_reroll: Set CanReroll false; append old cards to choice history with wasPicked false; set hasBeenRerolled; clear cards; Populate uses original RerollOptions verbatim.
contracts.kaleidoscope_fault: Its empty custom Other/RegularEncounter/NoUpgradeRoll reroll pool has no IsCardReward flag. PrismaticGem/DingyRug do not replace it. One Rewards rarity draw precedes no_valid_rarity.
contracts.exception_boundary: The fault prevents factory return, AfterGenerated, screen RefreshOptions and AfterRewardTaken; no UI recovery or terminal gameplay outcome is fabricated.
contracts.manual_modifiers: Hook.TryModifyCardRewardOptions itself runs regular and late listener passes. Manual CardReward construction does not subscribe RelicObtained; ordinary options construction does.
contracts.alternative_count_fault: Generate adds Skip (when CanSkip), then Reroll (when CanReroll), then PaelsWing adds Sacrifice. More than2 throws InvalidOperationException. OnSelect calls Generate before ShowScreen and ReserveChoiceId, so cards/history/RNG stay unchanged. Source-compatible flat actions which would open that screen are deliberately masked; RewardSet Proceed remains separate.
contracts.alternative_fault_precedence: If a card selection screen cannot open due to the alternative limit, the reroll oracle refuses to fabricate a later factory fault as the first event.
